name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Lint code
        uses: super-linter/super-linter/slim@v8.3.2
        env:
          VALIDATE_ALL_CODEBASE: true
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: main
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  build:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        build_type: [Debug, Release]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup build tools
        uses: microsoft/onnxruntime-github-actions/setup-build-tools@v0.0.8
        with:
          cmake-version: '3.22.0'
          cmake-hash: 'a7b6c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5'
          add-cmake-to-path: true
          vcpkg-version: '2023.02.05'
          vcpkg-hash: 'b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6'

      - name: Configure CMake
        uses: lukka/run-cmake@v3
        with:
          cmakeListsTxtPath: CMakeLists.txt
          cmakeBuildType: ${{ matrix.build_type }}
          buildDirectory: build

      - name: Build
        run: |
          cd build
          cmake --build . --config ${{ matrix.build_type }}

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd build
          ctest -C ${{ matrix.build_type }} --output-on-failure

  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup build tools
        uses: microsoft/onnxruntime-github-actions/setup-build-tools@v0.0.8
        with:
          cmake-version: '3.22.0'
          cmake-hash: 'a7b6c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5'
          add-cmake-to-path: true
          vcpkg-version: '2023.02.05'
          vcpkg-hash: 'b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6'

      - name: Configure CMake
        uses: lukka/run-cmake@v3
        with:
          cmakeListsTxtPath: CMakeLists.txt
          cmakeBuildType: Release
          buildDirectory: build

      - name: Build
        run: |
          cd build
          cmake --build . --config Release

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          cd build
          ctest -C Release --output-on-failure

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: testspace-com/setup-testspace@v1
        with:
          domain: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_DOMAIN }}
          token: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_TOKEN }}
          config-args: --project caesar0301/pkt2flow
